meta.dial_vintage: current-weights; rows before 2026-07-02 are the recompute vintage; dial window 2016-07+

fixed_rules.rule: midterm 0.75x, whole book incl OVS (stacks on live tilt)
OLV 0.5x when SPY within 3% of 252d high
ATR Ext Gap Up 0.5x when rv21 < 12
book 0.8x when SPY within 3% of high
LT Trend ST OS 0.5x at PIT dial >= 50 (2018+)
LT Trend ST OS 0.5x at current dial >= 65 (2016+)
